title: Pub Quiz Stills
eyebrow: BadCode Shorts · Pub Quiz: Housing · round 1
heading: The look: the pub and the quizmaster
intro: Round 3: the twelve shots of the short in your picked look. Pick a take per shot, or note what to change. Earlier rounds are folded below.

sections.h: Round 3: the shots, in story order
sections.lede: Your picked quizmaster and table, in twelve shots that follow the script. Quizmaster masks checked up close: all right.

groups.title: 1. The question
groups.line: Wide: the quizmaster at the bar asks the question, the room looks up at him.

groups.title: 2. The huddle starts
groups.line: The four pull in round the small table, heads together over one sheet.

groups.title: 3. The pen
groups.line: Insert: a hand writes a number on the answer sheet with a short pencil.

groups.title: 4. Crossed out
groups.line: The plasterer's dusty hand strikes through the number, his face insistent at the edge.

opts.label: a
opts.warn: Flow merged two people: the plaster-dusted jacket is on the man in the waterproof (Bob), not the plasterer you picked. Fixed on pick

opts.label: b
opts.warn: Flow merged two people: the plaster-dusted jacket is on the man in the waterproof (Bob), not the plasterer you picked. Fixed on pick

groups.title: 5. The beer mat
groups.line: The young man in the hoodie does sums on a beer mat.

groups.title: 6. Eavesdroppers
groups.line: The next table leans in to listen; the plasterer turns round and glares.

opts.label: a
opts.warn: Same mix-up: the dusty jacket is on the white man, not the plasterer. Fixed on pick

opts.label: b
opts.warn: Same mix-up: the dusty jacket is on the white man, not the plasterer. Fixed on pick

groups.title: 7. The banker
groups.line: The man in the suit, eyes on his pint, dismissive mid-sentence.

groups.title: 8. Bob takes the pen
groups.line: The quiet man in the waterproof jacket takes the pen and the sheet; the others watch.

opts.label: a
opts.warn: Check: the man in the waterproof jacket looks a lot like a well-known actor (my guess). Fixed on pick, never a famous face

opts.label: b
opts.warn: Check: the man in the waterproof jacket looks a lot like a well-known actor (my guess). Fixed on pick, never a famous face

groups.title: 9. The nod
groups.line: The man in the suit reads the turned sheet and gives a small nod.

groups.title: 10. Pens down
groups.line: Pens down: the quizmaster, microphone up, answer card in hand, looking out.

groups.title: 11. The answer lands
groups.line: The four frozen, all eyes on the quiet man's sheet.

groups.title: 12. The way out
groups.line: The young man in the hoodie asks, open-handed; the man in the suit turns to him.
